text:
Anas: Heads-up: leadership wants us to keep the public GA ship window but we must trim scope to defend latency and error SLOs. Need a minimal "must-ship" list + what we can safely push to post-GA. Quick estimates please.

Sam: Engineering view: biggest time sinks are the multi-org dashboard and promptstore full-text indexing. Neither are required for API parity. If we drop them we free up ~25% dev bandwidth over the next 6 weeks. Quantization/beam size tuning should remain.

Jia: UX: If dashboard is out, we need a very small admin UX for org management & model pinning. I can produce a 1-screen admin and copy for support in 48 hours if API is stable.

Marco: Ops: traffic routing experiments and burst scaling are still brittle. If we remove smart routing from GA, we need a fallback routing policy to avoid cascading failures. I can ship fallback + 48h canary in us-west but need an SRE pair.

Kelly: Product: Customer priorities matrix: SSO + audit logs and per-customer model pinning are blockers for two enterprise pilots. Other items (dashboard, embeddings explorer) are lower priority. We should decide whether enterprise pilots get private/dedicated tracks.

Oliver: From CS: Pilot "Atlas" requires SSO + audit logs for compliance. Pilot "Beacon" can wait 3-4 weeks. Atlas will tolerate a private pilot if we give a clear runbook and timeline.

Anas: Draft cutlist below (proposed for GA):
```yaml
core_for_ga:
  - inference_api
  - auth_token_lifecycle
  - telemetry_route_level
  - model_version_pinning
  - rate_limit_enforcement
defer_post_ga:
  - multi_org_dashboard
  - promptstore_fulltext
  - embeddings_explorer_ui
  - rollout_ab_testing_ui
  - advanced_smart_routing
```
Notes: keep SSO & audit logs on the path for enterprise pilots unless they opt to go private.

Sam: That cutlist is doable. Suggested resource move: pause dashboard feature dev, reassign two frontend/back-end pairs to infra and API stabilization for 6 weeks. Estimate: reduces planned velocity ~28%.

Jia: I'll deliver the single admin UI + support copy in 2 days and attach mocks. That should reduce customer friction when dashboard is missing.

Marco: Fallback routing plan: implement simple cost-based fallback (prefer low-latency pool, else fallback to compatible model variant). Timeline: 1 week build, 2 days canary, monitoring hooks. Need 1 infra + 1 SRE.

Kelly: Exec decision point: Do we require SSO for public GA? Recommendation: GA without mandatory SSO, but publish an "enterprise readiness" checklist and keep private/dedicated pilot path for customers wanting SSO+audit at launch. That keeps momentum.

Oliver: Confirmed with Atlas: private pilot acceptable if we give a 6-week timeline and onboarding support.

Sam: Plan tradeoffs: Plan A (GA without enforced SSO) => keeps ship date, increases support load for private pilots. Plan B (delay GA to fold SSO into GA) => ~3 week schedule slip but a smoother onboarding for Atlas. My engineering rec: go Plan A + dedicate 1 full-time support/solutions engineer for private pilot onboarding.

DeployBot: Canary window scheduled: 1719997200 -> 1719999000 (us-west). Auto-block if 5xx > 0.6% in window.

Anas: Actions: Sam: confirm reassigned devs today. Marco: open fallback routing ticket + schedule canary. Jia: ship admin UI + PR. Kelly/Oliver: finalize enterprise checklist & customer comms. I'll pull exec for a quick call by EOD if no objections. :thumbsup:

Sam: Will confirm names by EOD.

Marco: Created ticket and tagged oncall.

Jia: PR opened with mock images.

Oliver: Draft customer note uploaded to support drive.

Anas: Thanks all — unless someone raises a blocker, this becomes the formal scope trim for GA.
